description: Identify all nodes violating the AVL balance condition.
hints: The balance factor is calculated as height(left subtree) minus height(right subtree).
A node is balanced when its balance factor is -1, 0, or 1.
Identify every node whose absolute balance factor exceeds 1.

mission: Repair the vault using single rotations
description: Fix LL and RR imbalances using single rotations.
hints: An LL imbalance requires a right rotation.
An RR imbalance requires a left rotation.
Choose the correct pivot before performing the rotation.

description: Fix LR and RL imbalances using double rotations.
hints: An LR imbalance requires a left rotation on the left child, followed by a right rotation.
An RL imbalance requires a right rotation on the right child, followed by a left rotation.
Identify the imbalance case before selecting the rotations.

description: Insert treasures and predict required AVL rotations.
hints: Every insertion follows the standard BST insertion property.
Check balance factors while moving back toward the root.
Predict whether the resulting imbalance is LL, RR, LR, or RL.

mission: Steal the Kth most valuable treasure
description: Find the Kth smallest value and key ranks.
hints: Each node stores the total number of nodes in its subtree.
Use the size of the left subtree to determine the position of the current node.
Update subtree sizes after every rotation.
The Kth smallest operation should use subtree sizes instead of a complete inorder traversal.
